info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Custom Dimensions API
info.description: The Custom Dimensions API lets you manage and access reports for your configured Custom Dimensions.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) Custom dimension ID to load the report for.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website to query.
(Required) The period to process, processes data for the period containing the specified date.
(Required) The date or date range to process. 'YYYY-MM-DD', magic keywords (today, yesterday, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear), or date range (ie, 'YYYY-MM-DD,YYYY-MM-DD', lastX, previousX).
Custom segment to filter the report. Example: "referrerName==example.com" Supports AND (;) and OR (,) operators.
Whether subtables should be expanded in the response.
Whether subtable rows should be flattened into a single table.
Optional subtable ID to load.

request.description: Returns the report for a configured custom dimension. Only reports for active dimensions can be fetched.

response.name:
OK

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

item.name: Custom dimensions configure new custom dimension

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website to configure the dimension for.
(Required) The custom dimension name.
(Required) The dimension scope. Use `CustomDimensions.getAvailableScopes` for an up-to-date list.
(Required) Whether the custom dimension should be active.
Whether extraction matching should be case-sensitive.
Optional description to provide additional context for the custom dimension.

request.description: Configures a new custom dimension for a site. Note that custom dimensions cannot be deleted, so be careful when creating one as you might run out of available custom dimension slots.

response.name:
ID of the configured custom dimension. Note that the same ID may be used for different websites.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

item.name: Custom dimensions configure existing custom dimension

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) Custom dimension ID to update.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website the dimension belongs to.
(Required) The custom dimension name.
(Required) Whether the custom dimension should be active.
Whether extraction matching should be case-sensitive. Use `null` to keep the current setting.
Optional description to provide additional context for the custom dimension. Use `null` to keep the current description.

request.description: Updates an existing custom dimension. This method updates all values, so you need to pass existing values of the dimension if you do not want to reset any value.
